notes: «وغير، واحد» is the unnamed transmitter «غير واحد» and stands in the same level as محمد بن يحيى (co-transmitters after «قالوا حدثنا»)
«وهو ابن سارية» is an editor's gloss and is left out; «أبيها» is a bare relation for the Companion's father
«سئل أبو عاصم عن المجثمة» after the matn is a further explanation by محمد بن يحيى, not a second chain
